contexts.text: Purification from falsities is signified by... she shall poll her head (). AE 555:16.
Laban went to shear his flock () = a state of use and an end of good... To shear = use, thus end. AC 4853.
That to shear the flock = to perform use, is evident from the fact, that in the internal sense, the shearing of the flock is nothing but use; for wool comes thence. Illustrated.
Hence sheep-shearing, and to be near the shearers, was an honourable office. Illustrated.
Shearers () = use; thus to will use, or to consult for. AC 4857.

[Joseph] polled himself () = rejection and change as to the things of the exterior Natural. To poll, to wit, the head and beard = to reject such things as are of the exterior Natural; for the hair which was polled = that Natural. Illustrated... Hence those who have been rational appear there with hair becomingly dressed.
Not to shave the head... but in polling to poll the head () = not to reject the Natural, but to accommodate it to agreement; thus to subordinate it. Illustrated.
On fulfilling his Nazariteship, the Nazarite was to poll his head ().
Jehovah shall shave with a hired razor ().
Make thee bald, and shave thyself (). AE 724:12, Explained.
To cut the hair = to accommodate natural things so that they are becoming.
To shave the head () = to deprive of the internal truths of the Church; to shave the hair and consume the beard = to deprive of its external truths. AC 10044:3.
To crop the head, to shave the beard, and to cause baldness, = to deprive of all truth and good; for he who is deprived of ultimates is also deprived of prior things. Illustrated.
